title: Intent node
description: SoT §15.3 Intent node, with DEC-2026-10-16 contract-and-pack-clarifications C2: a pack has few nodes (the fintech pack has two); question types and requested remedies are slots, never nodes.

vocabulary.description: For a Reference slot: the closed pack vocabulary (for example question_type, PERD §20.4).

references.description: For a Reference slot whose values are registry IDs (for example requested_remedy).

auto_resolve_margin.description: A ratio in [0, 1]; a score margin, not money.

matcher_ref.description: The recipient matcher's data file, relative to the pack file's folder (for example fintech/lexicons/recipient_matcher.json). The model service reads it from a mounted pack directory; the image holds no pack (PERD REQ-AMB-003, DEC-2026-10-20 D5).

options_key.description: A555: the pack's question key for OPTIONS mode (a pack template id, as clarification.v1 question_key). Declared with display_template and attribute_order, or not at all (packcheck).

display_template.description: A555: the label of one candidate in OPTIONS mode. Literal text and {attr:<candidate field>} placeholders only (packcheck: the fields a label may show, no digit of its own, no two placeholders side by side). Produced by core from the masked candidate, never by a model (REQ-AMB-004).

attribute_order.description: A555: the pack's fixed order of askable attributes (ask by attribute, DEC-2026-10-20 D4); ties between attributes are broken by this order. Each carries the attribute's question key and the template of the label of one option value.

write_when.description: A364 (interim, relayed): a predicate in the pack's predicate language over this node's slots, evaluated on the admitted intent's resolved slots (an absent slot is null). True means the intent needs write evaluation. Optional; absent means it never does. packcheck checks that it parses, is Boolean and uses only this node's slot names; an unevaluable one is an error at run time, never a silent false.

subject_slot.description: A520 (interim; DEBT-54): the name of the slot of THIS node whose resolved reference is the subject of the intent, for the epoch of its resolution (A345 S1). Optional; absent means the node has no subject (a node with no Resource slot). packcheck checks that it names a Resource slot of this node. The core reads the name from the pack and never writes it in code (INV-14).

action_graph.description: A645, A647 (interim): the id of the action graph (action-graph.v2) whose write capability an admitted intent of this node confirms. Optional; absent means the node leads to no graph. packcheck checks that the pack declares a graph with this id. The core reads it from the pack and never from a setting or from code (INV-14).
